og_title: Han Li Finally Forms His Golden Core — RMJI Chapter 404
og_description: The long-awaited breakthrough is here. Han Li steps out of seclusion with a four-colored Golden Core, evolved beetle swarms, and a treasure plan that’s been decades in the making.
twitter_title: Core Formation Complete! Han Li’s New Power Revealed 🚀
twitter_description: After 60 years of cultivation, Han Li emerges with a Golden Core, golden-flecked beetles, and a legendary sword treasure on his mind.

lore_anchors.definition: The third major cultivation realm, where liquid Foundation Establishment energy is compressed into a solid Golden Core, granting 500–600 years of lifespan and the ability to use Nascent Flame.
A dark-aligned alternative to the standard Golden Core, produced by forbidden cultivation methods and locked to a different advancement path.
A legendary strain of insect that devours metal and spirit energy; in this chapter, they have evolved into a golden-flecked swarm through controlled cannibalism and accelerated feeding.
Rare spider-type demonic beasts; these two have been nurtured to peak fourth-rank with Spirit Nourishing Pills, now resembling crystalline White Jade Spiders.
A matched set of flying swords described on the golden page; once forged and nurtured with Nascent Flame, it can deploy the Sword Image Splitting Technique for overwhelming area attacks.
A high-level sword cultivator ability that manifests phantom sword images identical to the user's flying sword, scaling with cultivation depth.
A self-created cultivation technique that compresses qi through multiple revolutions to increase Core Formation odds; Han Li has completed the Second Revolution.
A foundational mental cultivation technique from the Thousand Bamboo School that strengthens divine sense and may improve Core Formation success when practiced to a high level.
The internal fire of a Core Formation cultivator, used to refine and nurture magical treasures within the body.

cultural_notes_faq.a: Core Formation is the third major realm in xianxia cultivation, where liquid energy condenses into a solid Golden Core in the dantian, granting dramatically increased lifespan and the ability to use Nascent Flame for treasure refinement.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li's Gold Devourer Beetles evolve so fast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used a secret method: feeding them accelerated Nightshade Grass (ripened by the Heaven Vial) triggered a controlled cannibalism cycle, causing rapid generational evolution and the appearance of golden carapace flecks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Azure Bamboo Cloudswarm Sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a legendary matched set of flying swords described on the golden page; once forged and nurtured with Nascent Flame, it can unleash the Sword Image Splitting Technique, producing multiple phantom swords for overwhelming area attacks.

A Demonic Core is a dark-aligned alternative to the standard Golden Core, formed through forbidden cultivation methods; cultivators who form one are locked into a different, usually more dangerous, advancement path.
